$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId pins the actor the first deploy created, so CI updates it by ID and a rename of name in actor.json keeps the same actor.
seoTitle: Job Search API for 18 Job Boards and ATS Sites
seoDescription: Search Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby, Hiring Cafe, YC, Wellfound and 11 more job boards in one run. Newest jobs first, each listed once, live data.
defaultRunOptions$comment: 8 GB, measured on Apify 2026-11-13 (build 1.0.2, engine 0.7.1, unpriced): all 18 boards, data analyst in London, read every board in 226 s at 8 GB, $0.108 (run o2nAAuWdvv2J3thKw), and at 4 GB cut five boards at the 240 s cap, $0.061 (run 5UinVyNmcwAwdzQzJ): Apify gives one CPU core per 4 GB, and 18 boards need two. The example input (5 boards) took 134 s at 4 GB, $0.037 (run vBjae5QuQQbltOdoH). maxMemoryMbytes 16384 lets a run take four cores. timeoutSecs 900: secondsPerBoard (240) caps the search, the rest is details and saving.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-13, first pricing while private, measured on Apify (build 1.0.3, engine 0.7.2, unpriced, 8 GB): all 18 boards, data analyst in London, 50 jobs: 236 s, $0.113 platform usage (run TJaEOQIdXUZvVlrZY); the example input (5 boards, 100 jobs): 113 s, $0.057 (run h5vOveiMdjdtEtK4Q). Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. Rivals with 80+ u30 on 2026-11-13 (100 jobs, free plan, start at default memory): fantastic-jobs API $1.21 (1,607 u30), hirebase $0.50, factpipe $0.50, memo23 $0.43, jobo $0.40, agentx $0.36 (42 platforms, the closest product), fantastic feed $0.35, jtpalms $0.30, yugenox $0.20, bovi $0.15. job $0.004 sits under hirebase and factpipe ($0.005). board $0.01: a search reads every company on each board whatever it saves, so the fee pays for the scan (18 boards $0.18 against $0.113 of usage). Margin, FREE, platform cost against 0.8 x revenue: all 18 boards + 100 jobs ($0.58) 76%, + 50 jobs ($0.38) 63%; 5 boards + 100 jobs ($0.45) 84%. Gentle ladder (owner, 2026-10-29) on job and job-details; board flat like start fees. No apify-actor-start: the board fee is the start fee. Owner to confirm before isPublic.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, places, work type, job type, pay, posting date, the board it came from and its links. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, pay as numbers with its currency, and the address.

board.eventDescription: Charged once for each job board a search reads, when the run starts: 18 when every board is searched. It pays for reading every company on that board, whatever the search saves. Checking job links charges none.
